import os,glob,re
def load():

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    a=np.array(A)
    for name,B in [('id',a),('h',a[:,::-1]),('v',a[::-1]),('180',a[::-1,::-1]),('t',a.T),('th',a.T[:,::-1]),('tv',a.T[::-1]),('r90',a.T[::-1,::-1])]:
        out[name]=B
    return out

            res[c]=(r0,c0,r1,c1)
